record.name: Reducto
record.one_liner: Reducto is an agentic document platform providing parsing, extraction, splitting, editing, and classification APIs for AI teams.

auth.notes: Uses a Bearer token in the Authorization header (e.g., Authorization: Bearer <token>).

access.notes: Offers a free tier with credits ($150 / 15,000 free credits) and a self-serve API Quickstart to parse documents in minutes.

api_surface.notes: Provides REST endpoints and SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go, plus custom webhooks.

mcp.notes: Provides an MCP server to give agents Reducto tools directly in MCP clients like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve access with free credits, clear API documentation, and code examples in Python, Node.js, and Go.

evidence.claim: Reducto parse r-1 reads documents and outputs structured data and bounding-box citations.
Capabilities include Classify, Parse, Extract, Split, Edit, and Pipelines, available via API & SDKs (Python, Node.js, Go, REST) and an MCP server.
Includes Parse API, Extract API, Edit API, Split API, and Custom Webhooks, with free credits to start.
Demonstrates the Parse API endpoint using Bearer token authentication in Python, Node.js, and Go.
